about_the_game:
When purchasing the official version, the progress of the demo will be automatically carried over.

Joyquarium is a very stress - relieving idle game. You can raise fish manually or use the Auto - AFK function. Sell the grown fry to make money. You can also keep the adult fish in the fish tank to generate considerable income.

Buy fry packs to unlock new fish!

Feed the little fish and watch them eagerly scramble for food!

Unlock rare shiny and colorful forms! There's also a chance to raise a king fish!

Water wisteria, Rotala rotundifolia, Ludwigia repens, Hygrophila polysperma 'Roraima', Apistogramma viejita... A wide variety of aquatic plants, as well as driftwoods of different postures and strange - looking landscaping stones, are waiting for you to arrange.

Up to 13 cool filter effects are available for you to freely combine, and the visual effects are ever - changing!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win10
  • Processor: i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win11
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM

short_description: Joyquarium is a relaxing casual fish-raising game. Buy various cute fry at a low price and sell them at a high price after they grow up. With the money you earn, you can purchase aquatic plants, driftwood, scenery stone, etc. to decorate your tank (you can adjust the color, size, and position).
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Ukrainian, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
